title: GFCC Identity Port v1 (PPI)
description: Personal-public identity for 格契. Values, capability trace, commitments, builder tags, and human-chosen value axes. Role = growth stage (能不能); builder_tags = craft (擅长做什么). uid is ethos Principal.sub. Paid tier is quota only.

principal.roles: see roles.v1.json (growth ladder in JWT claims)

interim_auth.role: 市场角色（candidate / recruiter / admin）。本版不改为 roles[]。
interim_auth.notes: 过渡。八角梯仍以 roles.v1.json 为准，留待 ethos 那一版进入 claims。

builder_tags.description: 营造师标签，可多选。与八角梯正交。

trace_sources.notes: evidence may mint capability_trace. auxiliary may annotate only. No 'optional' source.

values.description: Declared values; not a match score by itself

role_evidence_ids.description: Dual / CoCo record ids that justify the current ladder step. AI observation alone is not enough.

value_axes.description: Cumulative points from signal value_axis_choice only. survival=钱多, freedom=事少, belonging=离家近. Absent until the first human choice. Not a match score. The kernel returns this raw snapshot. Normalization stays in job_match and is not written back. These integers are not comparable across users. job_match may read this object and must not write it.

upsert_profile.notes: Self-write of values/commitments/builder_tags. Role changes go through roles.v1 transitions. Humans do not self-mint capability_trace. This operation does not write value_axes.

append_trace.notes: Only evidence-weight sources may mint capability. Auxiliary (job_match/mbti/ai_observed) annotates. contribution.fulfilled is the primary mint path. This operation does not write value_axes.

read_value_axes.notes: Returns the raw snapshot. A second read does not change it. identity.read does not grant this scope.

apply_value_axis.notes: Only signal value_axis_choice may add 1–5 points to the choice's own axis. Domain default axis is not a writer. job_match must not call this. identity.write does not grant this scope.

optional_plugins.career_trace: JobFirst resume/job_match may feed capability_trace as auxiliary and must read value_axes when present. Job scores stay job-scoped and are not identity itself.
optional_plugins.personality: MBTI-like input may annotate values as auxiliary; not an entry port
